name: 倉頡
label: 倉

source.words: rime-cangjie's Cangjie 5 (LGPL-3.0; its dictionary, from 倉頡之友's 五倉世紀, marked GPL) and rime-essay (LGPL-3.0)

howTo: Type each character's Cangjie code, up to five keys: the code shows as its radicals as you type (hqi is 竹手戈, for 我).

First, pick your characters on this page: Simplified, Hong Kong or Taiwan. Your code floats above the bar and the choices sit over the top row. Space types the first one, and a tap picks any. For more, press Shift, swipe up on the keys, or tap ⋯. Enter or a swipe turns the page. Next words follow each pick. Enter types the code as letters, and double Space types 。.

guide.line: Characters by their shapes, up to five parts.
points: Type a character's parts in order: hqi (竹手戈) gives 我.
The code shows as radicals as you type.
